title: Lesson 56 - Diagnosing a Quality Regression from Session Data
description: Explain agent analytics and agent optimization.

questions.question: Escalation Rate rose overall, and a breakdown shows the increase is concentrated in one intent. Which capability produced that localization?
options: The Session Outcome stack bar chart
Performance Insights, which breaks a metric down by subagent, intent, or action
questions.explanation: Performance Insights provides the per-subagent, per-intent, and per-action breakdowns that localize a trend before you open sessions.

questions.question: A session failed and you must tell a failing external action apart from a bad retrieval. Where do you look?
options: The Effectiveness tab, which shows the rates
The Trace tab, which shows the time-ordered steps with per-step timing and error text
The filter bar, which scopes the dashboard
The saves views menu, which stores your columns
questions.explanation: Trace lists every processing step with its timing and any error text, which is what separates a failing action from a slow or wrong retrieval.

questions.question: A filter returns no results for a session you know happened. Which explanation fits?
options: The session exceeded the default two hour timeout and was deleted
The agent has more than one active version
Its intent is an untagged instance that did not join a cluster, so it does not appear in the session trace
The agent was deactivated at the time of the session
questions.explanation: Untagged intents do not appear in the session trace even though the session holds them, so a low-volume intent can be missing from the trace view.
